name: Doha
summary: Qatar's capital curves around a bay of glittering towers. It has world-class museums, including I. M. Pei's Museum of Islamic Art and the desert-rose National Museum, a lively rebuilt souq, and dunes that run down to an inland sea in the south.
seasonNote: November to March is warm and pleasant. April and October are hot; May to September is extremely hot and humid. Ramadan changes opening hours, and eating in public by day is discouraged.
arrival: Hamad International Airport is 20 minutes from the centre by metro or taxi; Doha is a major stopover hub, and many nationalities get visa-free entry.
gettingAround: The Doha Metro is cheap and clean; taxis and ride-hailing cover the rest.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere; carry some riyals for the souq.
foodTip: Machboos (spiced rice with meat), luqaimat dumplings with date syrup, and karak tea.
buyTip: Dates, oud perfume, spices and falconry gear at Souq Waqif.
baseArea: West Bay, Msheireb or near Souq Waqif
